mapper.select: SELECT banner_id, banner_name, placement, image_url, link_url, alt_text, display_order, starts_at, ends_at, is_active, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM banners WHERE is_active = 1 AND placement = #{placement} ORDER BY display_order ASC, banner_id ASC

SELECT banner_id, banner_name, placement, image_url, link_url, alt_text, display_order, starts_at, ends_at, is_active, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM banners ORDER BY placement ASC, display_order ASC, banner_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO banners(banner_name, placement, image_url, link_url, alt_text, display_order, starts_at, ends_at, is_active, created_by) VALUES (#{bannerName}, #{placement}, #{imageUrl}, #{linkUrl}, #{altText}, #{displayOrder}, #{startsAt}, #{endsAt}, 1, #{createdBy})
